deltas.rule: The TCP shall detail all devices, hours of work, days, dimensions of tapers and barricades, and the work area — and shall provide a device summary on the sheet.
deltas.baseline: MUTCD imposes no on-sheet device summary requirement

effect.note: on-sheet device summary block required unconditionally

hours.override_note: Written Local Entity Engineer authorization required outside windows. These windows are metered in Loveland: time-restriction violations are fined per half-hour by street class (see meters). City-project practice runs 7 a.m.-6 p.m. M-F (practice, not rule); normal inspection hours defined as M-F 7:30-16:30 on the fee schedule.

personnel.rule: All work covered by a TCP shall be performed by a Traffic Control Supervisor, and a certificate for the TCS shall be submitted with the TCP.

source.doc: LCUASS Ch.6

personnel.rule: On all collector and arterial streets (and some locals per the Local Entity Engineer), a named individual responsible for traffic control must be contactable 24 hours/day and certified as a TCS by ATSSA and/or CCA.

source.doc: LCUASS Ch.6

hazards.rule: Work-hours violations are metered per half-hour or portion thereof, priced by street class — up to $700 per half-hour on arterial/State/US-highway streets.

source.doc: Loveland DRAFT 2026 Fee Schedule (council packet Att. 4)

hazards.rule: Exceeding the permitted completion date is fined per day, graduated by street class and closure type — up to $1,750/day for an arterial street closure.

source.doc: Loveland DRAFT 2026 Fee Schedule (council packet Att. 4)

hazards.rule: Loveland monetizes schedule integrity end to end: inaccurate dates on a ROW application are fine-bearing, and failure to give the required 48-hour notice is a separately priced line item.

source.doc: Loveland ROW Permits page (lovgov.org) + DRAFT 2026 Fee Schedule

tiers.label: Minor ROW Permit
tiers.definition: Minimal traffic control — e.g. residential driveway cuts, shoulder work.

source.doc: Loveland DRAFT 2026 Fee Schedule (council packet Att. 4)

tiers.label: Major ROW Permit
tiers.definition: Major traffic control — e.g. arterial lane closures and/or detours.

source.doc: Loveland DRAFT 2026 Fee Schedule (council packet Att. 4)

notes.rule: The permit tier is defined by the traffic-control footprint: Minor = 'minimal traffic control', Major = 'major traffic control (arterial lane closures and/or detours)'. The computed closure type determines which Loveland permit applies.

notes.rule: ROW Contractor's license required (city limits), with endorsements by category; license bond $20,000 plus $10,000 per endorsement, continuous, 60-day cancellation notice, survives through warranty.

notes.rule: Surety: Loveland exception — 15% of public-improvement cost (LCUASS default is 100%). Insurance: $1M CGL + $1M auto, Local Entity named insured, 30-day notice.

source.doc: LCUASS Ch.6

notes.rule: Residential streets inside city limits may not need a separate TCP; devices still per MUTCD Part 6.

notes.rule: Right-of-Way Permit expires 30 days from approval. Development Construction Permit: void if work not started in 60 days; 1-year life plus 90-day extensions (apply at least 2 weeks early). No fee refunds once collected, even if the permit expires unused.
